May I step APP's system clock forward once from that RTC after fresh cross-checks, verify skew below two seconds, and then start coordinator and authority once more for the signed readiness checks? This will not change firewalls, NTP configuration, the website or HTTPS, and it will not request a threshold signature or payment.
